caption: The drawing depicts a wooden bench with a straight back and a flat seat, both featuring visible horizontal planks. The bench is rendered in shades of light brown with subtle variations to suggest wood grain and shadowing, and the lines are clean and precise, indicating the construction details. The bench has two end panels that form the armrests and legs; the armrests curve slightly upwards and outward at their tops. There is a central vertical support underneath the seat, dividing the open space below into three sections, with one central support panel creating additional stability. The backrest features a horizontal upper rail and a rectangular open section at the top, separated by a vertical support in the middle. The overall composition uses minimal shading to indicate depth and light, with the bench centered on a plain, beige background.
title: Meeting House Pew
